answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 9410 Country: India Title: Assalaam u Alaikum, Is it permissible for a women to travel alone or with other women from Mumbai to jeddah By air for performing Haj/Umra? She will be accompanied by her husband once she reaches Jeddah. Question: Assalaam u Alaikum, Is it permissible for a women to travel alone or with other women from Mumbai to jeddah By air for performing Haj/Umra? She will be accompanied by her husband once she reaches Jeddah. Answer ID: 9410 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1247/1247=M/1429) In the abovementioned case, a woman is not allowed to travel from Mumbai to Jeddah alone or with a woman. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
